svg.title: Proposed planning and implementation dependency matrices
svg.desc: Proposed dependency charts, not implemented progress or a time schedule. Rows are phases and columns are prerequisites. Filled cells mean a dependency in the draft source. Planning: PH-00 needs none; PH-01 needs PH-00; PH-02 needs PH-00; PH-03 needs PH-00, PH-01, PH-02; PH-04 needs PH-00, PH-03; PH-05 needs PH-00, PH-02, PH-03; PH-06 needs PH-00, PH-01, PH-03, PH-04, PH-05; PH-07 needs PH-00, PH-02, PH-06; PH-08 needs PH-00, PH-01, PH-02, PH-03, PH-04, PH-05, PH-06, PH-07; PH-09 needs PH-00. Implementation: PH-00 needs none; PH-01 needs PH-02; PH-02 needs PH-00; PH-03 needs PH-01, PH-02; PH-04 needs PH-03; PH-05 needs PH-02, PH-03; PH-06 needs PH-01, PH-02, PH-03, PH-04, PH-05; PH-07 needs PH-02, PH-06; PH-08 needs PH-01, PH-02, PH-03, PH-04, PH-05, PH-06, PH-07; PH-09 needs PH-08. PH-01 portfolio and imports can be specified from PH-00 drafts, but its later implementation needs PH-02 foundations. Full end-to-end requirements and UX approval is required before implementation.
svg.text: Plan the layers; build behind their prerequisites
Exact draft dependencies from the phase map • No timeline, progress or implementation claim
PH-01 ledger: planning can precede foundations; implementation requires PH-02.
Standalone portfolio, all-method imports and source lineage
Identity, private runtime, audit and launch cost controls
Market data, performance and portfolio risk
Scientific baseline, full Forecaster and controlled learning
Evidence research, agents, chat and evaluations
Web discovery, ranked actions, proof and briefings
Operational acceptance and controlled personal launch
Versioned extensions and conditional future transfer
Proposed • Full end-to-end requirements and UX approval before application implementation
